[03–04] A day of calls

Two kinds of callers. Pick a call to see who's on the line.

Every plumbing company gets both. They search differently, decide differently and are won differently.

  • Homeowner, water on the floor. Wins: answered live, a time window in the first minute, a tech on site within the hour.

  • A water heater replacement in waiting. Wins: same-day slot, two options and financing explained on the call.

  • A researched, high-value job. Wins: reviews, photos of past repipes and a follow-up after the estimate.

  • A business losing money every hour. Wins: priority response and a maintenance schedule offered after the fix.

  • Compliance work that renews every year. Wins: reminders, reports and one contact for every building.

  • A property manager with tenants waiting. Wins: response time in writing and photos sent after the visit.

WHAT THEY TYPE (OR ASK AI)

“emergency plumber near me open now”

“water heater replacement same day {city}”

  • Residential: trust and speed decide

    Emergencies (leaks, clogs), water heaters and repipes. Answered live, a time window in the first minute.

  • Commercial: response and reporting

    Restaurants, property managers and facilities buy reliability: service contracts, backflow testing, after-hours calls.
